node.statement: For every X, exact unitality and the associator and product-norm axioms give ||X||<=epsilon_r||U||^2||X||+(1+epsilon_r)||U||*||U bold-dot X||. With epsilon_r<=1/64 and ||U||<=2 this yields ||U bold-dot X||>=(1/3)||X||. Hence L_U is injective; finite dimensionality makes it bijective and ||L_U^{-1}||<=3.
